# codemie_workflow (Resource)

Manages a CodeMie workflow. yaml_config is the recommended graph representation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "codemie_workflow" "example" {
  name        = "Review workflow"
  description = "Runs an automated code review workflow."
  project     = "example-project"
  mode        = "Sequential"
  shared      = true
  yaml_config = file("${path.module}/workflow.yaml")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `project` (String)

### Optional

- `assistants` (String) JSON workflow assistant array.
- `guardrail_assignments` (String) JSON guardrail assignment array.
- `icon_url` (String)
- `meta_config` (String)
- `mode` (String)
- `shared` (Boolean)
- `start_hint` (String)
- `states` (String) JSON workflow state array.
- `supervisor_prompt` (String)
- `tools` (String) JSON workflow tool array.
- `yaml_config` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
